author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete:
GO:0070221 sulfide oxidation, using sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase 
GO:0070222 sulfide oxidation, using sulfide dehydrogenase
GO:0070223 sulfide oxidation, using sulfur dioxygenase

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31842

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1UMOZEjLTHRJGWjWWehIzc_9wpgdLvUB2ubXZJdk7gUA/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 
GO:0070221 sulfide oxidation, using sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase 
UniProt 1
Reactome 2

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
InterPro2GO - 1

GO:0070221 | interpro2go | InterPro:IPR042457 Thiosulfate:glutathione sulfurtransferase, mammalian > GO:sulfide oxidation, using sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase ; GO:0070221






Thanks.
